declared_differences: NatureLM paper reports 50% sequence-identity clustering; released SciReason implementation uses 99% equal-length positional clustering.
NatureLM paper-native sample count, complete sampling/stopping setup and exact evaluator version remain unrecovered; 1000 and generation settings here come from SciReason code.

Official OmegaFold release2 is downloaded from Helixon S3 and its full SHA256 matches the pinned SciReason mirror LFS object; the SciReason fork runtime source is preserved.
Upstream all-invalid divide-by-zero is reported as undefined; failed folds retain full eligibility coverage rather than silently disappearing from the complete metric.
Prospective retained-task output cap is uniformly16384 instead of the earlier preparation/SciReason2048; all other released sampling settings retained.
Per-case evaluator identity and errors are preserved; source silent fold skipping is replaced by undefined full confidence when any eligible output lacks a successful score.
Native PDB/confidence files are retained as delivery artifacts; pLDDT remains predictor confidence, not experimental validity.
A dedicated finite-token decoder imposes one nonempty canonical tagged sequence. Format validity is imposed, preserved only as a source diagnostic and omitted from primary capability metrics.

The decoder changes the output sampling distribution while retaining original prompt/sampling settings, every token-feasible canonical sequence, and the uniform16384 output cap; there is no residue-count cutoff.
Two new artificial formatting prompts with seeds200042/200043 replace neither failed original pilot reply; the1000 original benchmark slots/seeds remain untouched before this condition.

Exact pinned legacyV1 logits processor plus finite EOS-only terminal state is mandatory. Any envelope, constraint, transport, refusal or truncation failure stops new sends and drains outstanding requests without retries.
result_claim: Released-code sequence-format, diversity and predictor-confidence proxies only; no experimental or functional validation.
